_comment: John: these are placeholders. Set them to your real preferences.
_bag_fee_note: Per-carrier checked/carry-on fee, added before comparing. Set NK/F9 if you'd check a bag; leave empty if you never do.
_cap_note: Day one has no history, so the cold-start path can fire on every itinerary. This caps alerts per sweep, keeping the cheapest.
_renotify_note: Debounce silences repeats, but a fare that keeps falling is news. Re-alert inside the debounce window if it dropped at least this much below the last announced price.
